tokens.name: ds-bg-0
tokens.usage: App ground: the nav rail and the canvas behind everything.

tokens.name: ds-bg-1
tokens.usage: The page. `ds-text-1/2/3` all read on it, and PageHeader sits on it.

tokens.name: ds-bg-2
tokens.usage: Panels, side rails, ActionBar, SegmentedControl and pill-Tabs containers, EntityCard.

tokens.name: ds-bg-3
tokens.usage: Inputs, popovers, dialogs, sheets, skeleton blocks, idle SeverityPicker segments.

tokens.name: ds-bg-4
tokens.usage: Hover, raised, toast, secondary Button, active nav item, selected segment.

tokens.name: ds-bg-5
tokens.usage: Pressed, and the ground of applied token chips (`Chip variant="token"`).

tokens.name: ds-border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairline inside a surface: PageHeader's bottom edge, EntityCard, segment containers, `ds-elev-1`.

tokens.name: ds-border
tokens.usage: The default 1px control and panel border: inputs, chips, SeverityPicker, ActionBar's top edge. Deliberately subtle: 1.3:1 against `ds-bg-3`, below the 3:1 WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.11 asks of component boundaries. See the README's Accessibility section.

tokens.name: ds-border-strong
tokens.usage: Secondary Button, input hover, EmptyState's dashed edge, key caps, the sheet grab handle. 1.7:1 against `ds-bg-4` dark — still below 3:1; see the README's Accessibility section.

tokens.name: ds-text-1
tokens.usage: Primary text: titles, values, card titles. 14.5:1 on `ds-bg-1` dark, 14.8:1 light.

tokens.name: ds-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body, field labels, ghost buttons, EmptyState message. 9.2:1 on `ds-bg-1` dark, 8.4:1 light.

tokens.name: ds-text-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: meta lines, counts, placeholders, uppercase group titles. 5.6:1 on `ds-bg-1` dark, 5.4:1 light; it holds 4.5:1 up to `ds-bg-3`. On `ds-bg-4` and above use `ds-text-2` — `ds-text-3` falls to 4.49:1 there in dark.

tokens.name: ds-text-inverse
tokens.usage: The inverse of `ds-text-1`, for text on a bright fill. Check the fill in both themes before using it: on `ds-danger` it is 2.9:1 in light, which is why a solid danger button uses `ds-danger-contrast` instead.

tokens.name: ds-accent
tokens.usage: Accent fills and marks: primary Button, active nav bar, progress, a focused input border, the Tabs underline.

tokens.name: ds-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: ds-accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent at body size: links, a Combobox create row, SourceBadge text. 4.5:1+ on `ds-bg-1` in both themes.

tokens.name: ds-accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected fills: a chip that is on, an applied SourceBadge, an Include segment.

tokens.name: ds-accent-tint-hover
tokens.usage: Hover over an already-selected accent-tint surface.

tokens.name: ds-accent-mixed
tokens.usage: The edge of a Chip in the mixed state (a bulk selection where only some items have the value): quieter than the `ds-accent` edge of a selected chip. The state is also announced through aria-pressed="mixed". 2.4:1 against `ds-bg-3` in dark and 3.1:1 in light — like the other control edges, below 3:1 in dark (see the README's Accessibility section).

tokens.name: ds-accent-contrast
tokens.usage: Text and key caps on a filled `ds-accent` ground. 5.8:1 dark, 6.2:1 light.

tokens.name: ds-accent-key
tokens.usage: Ground of a KeyCap sitting on a filled `ds-accent` (a primary Button): a lighter key in dark, a darker inset key in light. `ds-accent-contrast` reads on it at 7.5:1 dark and 9.4:1 light.

tokens.name: ds-accent-key-edge
tokens.usage: The edge and 2px bottom lip of a KeyCap on a filled `ds-accent`.

tokens.name: ds-success
tokens.usage: Positive mark: a tone bar, a dot, a check. Never a large fill.

tokens.name: ds-success-text
tokens.usage: Positive text and icons on `ds-bg-1` or `ds-success-tint`.

tokens.name: ds-success-tint
tokens.usage: Positive tinted ground; carries `ds-success-text`.

tokens.name: ds-warning
tokens.usage: Caution mark, and the border of a warning-tone Chip.

tokens.name: ds-warning-tint

tokens.name: ds-danger
tokens.usage: Negative fill: a Dialog's solid confirm, an invalid control's border.

tokens.name: ds-danger-text

tokens.name: ds-danger-tint

tokens.name: ds-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a Dialog or Sheet, and under a card's duration pill.

tokens.name: ds-focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, 2px at 2px offset on every interactive element. 3:1+ on every ground it lands on.
